# ipify
> A simple public IP address API that returns a client’s public IPv4 or IPv6 address in plain text, JSON, or JSONP.

ipify provides a fast, unauthenticated API for discovering the caller’s public IP address, with separate endpoints for IPv4, IPv6, and dual-stack usage. The site also links to the companion IP Geolocation API for location data based on IP addresses.

## Main Documentation
- [ipify API Homepage](https://www.ipify.org/): Overview of the public IP API, usage formats, and language examples.
- [API Usage](https://www.ipify.org/): Documents plain text, JSON, and JSONP response formats for all endpoints.
- [Code Samples](https://www.ipify.org/): Shows ready-to-run examples for Bash, NGS, Python, and Ruby.
- [Why ipify?](https://www.ipify.org/): Summarizes reliability, simplicity, and unlimited usage benefits.

## API Endpoints
- [Universal IP Endpoint](https://api64.ipify.org): Returns the caller’s public IP address with IPv4 or IPv6 support.
- [Universal IP Endpoint with JSON](https://api64.ipify.org?format=json): Returns the caller’s public IP address as a JSON object.
- [Universal IP Endpoint with JSONP](https://api64.ipify.org?format=jsonp&callback=getip): Returns the caller’s public IP address as JSONP.
- [IPv4 Endpoint](https://api.ipify.org): Returns the caller’s public IPv4 address in plain text.
- [IPv4 Endpoint with JSON](https://api.ipify.org?format=json): Returns the caller’s public IPv4 address as JSON.
- [IPv4 Endpoint with JSONP](https://api.ipify.org?format=jsonp&callback=getip): Returns the caller’s public IPv4 address as JSONP.
- [IPv6 Endpoint](https://api6.ipify.org): Returns the caller’s public IPv6 address in plain text.
- [IPv6 Endpoint with JSON](https://api6.ipify.org?format=json): Returns the caller’s public IPv6 address as JSON.

## Response Formats
- [Plain Text Response](https://api.ipify.org): Returns only the IP address as a raw text response.
- [JSON Response](https://api.ipify.org?format=json): Returns an object containing the `ip` field.
- [JSONP Response](https://api.ipify.org?format=jsonp&callback=getip): Wraps the IP response in a callback function.
- [Universal JSON Response](https://api64.ipify.org?format=json): Returns IPv4 or IPv6 in JSON depending on client connectivity.

## IP Version Options
- [IPv4 API](https://www.ipify.org/): Describes the endpoint dedicated to IPv4-only address retrieval.
- [IPv6 API](https://www.ipify.org/): Describes the endpoint dedicated to IPv6-only address retrieval.
- [Universal IPv4/IPv6 API](https://www.ipify.org/): Describes the dual-stack endpoint for mixed network environments.
- [IPv4 Plain Endpoint](https://api.ipify.org): Best for clients that specifically require IPv4 output.
- [IPv6 Plain Endpoint](https://api6.ipify.org): Best for clients operating on IPv6-capable networks.
- [Dual-Stack Plain Endpoint](https://api64.ipify.org): Best for clients that should accept either IP version.

## Language Examples
- [Bash Example](https://www.ipify.org/): Demonstrates fetching the public IP from a shell with curl.
- [NGS Example](https://www.ipify.org/): Demonstrates retrieving the public IP using Next Generation Shell.
- [Python Example](https://www.ipify.org/): Demonstrates requesting the API from Python code.
- [Ruby Example](https://www.ipify.org/): Demonstrates requesting the API from Ruby code.

## Related Services
- [IP Geolocation API](https://geo.ipify.org/): Companion API for geolocation, ISP, and network details by IP address.
- [IPify Geolocation Product Reference](https://geo.ipify.org/): Entry point for location-based lookups related to IP addresses.

## Integration Notes
- [No Authentication Required](https://www.ipify.org/): The API can be called directly without API keys or account setup.
- [Unlimited Usage](https://www.ipify.org/): Intended for unrestricted public IP lookup usage.
- [High Availability Overview](https://www.ipify.org/): Notes the service is designed to remain available even under heavy load.
- [Simple HTTPS Access](https://www.ipify.org/): All examples use straightforward HTTPS GET requests.
